entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...declined his offer."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "...agreed to let Wehlen send troops..."
entries.dialogueText: ...agreed to let Wehlen send troops to Rizia once more.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She accepted your invitation and an..."
entries.dialogueText:
She accepted your invitation and announced that the Kingdom of Rumburg would be intervening on King Romus' behalf.

In the following weeks, thousands of Rumburgian soldiers were deployed to Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rejected your request with regr..."
entries.dialogueText: She rejected your request with regrets. Rumburg was busy tied up in its own conflict with Sordland -- a large-scale war that was threatening to envelop all of Eastern Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "She rejected your request with regr..."
entries.dialogueText:
She rejected your request with regrets but promised support in the future. Rumburg had just begun its invasion of Sordland.

In the following weeks, a large-scale war enveloped Eastern Merkopa.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You had to fight alone."
entries.dialogueText: You had to fight alone.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Victory was on the horizon."
entries.dialogueText: Victory was on the horizon.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "In the following weeks, thousands o..."
entries.dialogueText:
In the following weeks, thousands of Wehzek soldiers were deployed to Rizia.

Not expecting a direct attack from the north, the rebels scattered upon the arrival of the Wehzek Armed Forces.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "Victory was close at hand."
entries.dialogueText: Victory was close at hand.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The offensive continued for weeks w..."
entries.dialogueText: The offensive continued for weeks with no signs of clear victory. Most of Porte Drazon was now in ruins.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Your siege made life in Porte Drazo..."
entries.dialogueText: Your siege made life in Porte Drazon hell for millions of civilians. Most of the city lay in ruins.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After condemning the civilian death..."
entries.dialogueText: After condemning the civilian deaths you had caused, Valgsland announced its official support for Rizia's new revolutionary government and ordered its army to intervene.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "And so foreign troops landed in Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: And so foreign troops landed in Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As a response to the Valgish interv..."
entries.dialogueText:

During this tumultuous time, Lucita gave birth to your son, {RiziaDLCText.KingsSon}.

entries.dialogueText: You regretted that this was the world he'd been born into.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The war in Rizia was soon eclipsed..."
entries.dialogueText: The war in Rizia was soon eclipsed by the larger-scale war between Rumburg and Sordland. The continent's attention shifted to the north as your own fight dragged on and on.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "There was no end in sight."
entries.dialogueText: There was no end in sight.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Over the next years, Rizia became a..."
entries.dialogueText:
Over the next years, Rizia became a playground for the superpowers. The ATO and CSP became more and more brazen with their intervention, and countless Rizian lives were claimed.

Rebuilding your kingdom was out of the question. All you could do was fight to stay in power.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "The crown wasn't worth it."
entries.dialogueText: The crown wasn't worth it.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After a sudden nuclear attack by Ru..."
entries.dialogueText:
After a sudden nuclear attack by Rumburg on the capital of Sordland, the CSP and ATO turned against each other.

With proxy armies from both superpowers installed in Rizia, your kingdom became a theater in a massive war that spanned the entire continent.

The chance for peace was out of your hands.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "All you could do was watch."
entries.dialogueText: All you could do was watch.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "A few months later, Rumburg had com..."
entries.dialogueText:
A few months later, Rumburg had completely cleared the enemy out of the country.

However, the Queen did not relinquish control of Porte Drazon completely. Nor did her armies return home.

She offered to reinstall you as King of Rizia in exchange for agreeing to be Rumburg's vassal state.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You bit the bullet and agreed."
entries.dialogueText: You bit the bullet and agreed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "After signing an official document..."
entries.dialogueText:
After signing an official document recognizing Queen Beatrice as your suzerain, you took back power in Porte Drazon.

Sitting on your throne once more, you surveyed the devastation around you. You had no idea of knowing how long it would take to rebuild.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "You rejected her offer and condemne..."
entries.dialogueText: You rejected her offer and condemned Rumburg for occupying Rizia.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The international community echoed..."
entries.dialogueText:
The international community echoed your condemnations. Heated accusations began flying from all sides, threatening the recently achieved peace.

Rumburg sent most of their troops home and allowed you to take power in the capital again, but their intervention never completely ceased.

For the rest of your life, you'd remain under Rumburg's thumb.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: "But it was all worth it."
entries.dialogueText: But it was all worth it.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: War never changes.

entries.dialogueText:

Palas Toras became a de facto command center, busy day and night with the delivery of war plans and the comings and goings of House Toras loyalists.

Your base outside the capital became a de facto command center, busy day and night with the delivery of war plans and the comings and goings of King Romus supporters.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus

entries.dialogueText: But the enemy was everywhere.

entries.speaker: Narrator

entries.dialogueText: Despite her advanced pregnancy, Lucita helped you organize an army to fight the revolutionaries.

entries.dialogueText: Late at night, you got a call from Lucita. She'd been busy helping organize an army to help you fight the revolutionaries.

entries.title: Narrator: "Late at night, you got a call from..."
entries.dialogueText: Late at night, you got a call from Carlos Azaro. Though his house was reluctant to join the fight against the revolutionaries, the soldiers in the Rizian Armed Forces still swore allegiance to you.
